title: Kellerjochbahn Schwaz
name: Kellerjochbahn Schwaz
kurzbeschreibung: The Kellerjochbahn near Schwaz: chairlifts to the scenic Kellerjoch at 1,887 m above sea level with the Kellerjochkapelle and 360-degree Inntal views.
beschreibung:
Overview

The storied Kellerjochbahn ascends from the sunny slopes above the historic mining town of Schwaz in the Tyrolean Unterinntal up to the Kellerjoch. Reaching an altitude of up to 1,887 metres, the lift provides access to one of North Tyrol's most spectacular scenic peaks. Owing to its freestanding position between the Inntal and the Zillertal, the summit of the Kellerjoch unfolds an incomparable 360-degree panorama: the vista extends from the glaciated Zillertaler Alpen and Hohe Tauern across the rugged peaks of the Karwendel to the Rofangebirge and Bavarian Prealps.

Nature, Hiking & Kellerjochkapelle

The Kellerjoch looks back on a long tradition as a hiking and winter sports mountain within the Silberregion Karwendel. From the Grafenast valley station, hikers glide comfortably in modern chairlifts up to the Alpengasthof Hecherhaus at 1,887 metres above sea level. From there, the popular ridge path leads in about an hour of alpine walking up to the 2,344-metre summit with the prominent Kellerjochkapelle: consecrated in 1928, this small chapel perches boldly atop the rocky pinnacle and is considered one of Western Austria's most iconic photographic motifs. Botany enthusiasts appreciate the lush alpine flora along the trails, where in early summer entire mountainsides bloom with vibrant alpine roses. For families, the adventure trail at the Grafenast station features engaging stops highlighting the history of Schwaz silver mining.

Visit & Getting There

The Kellerjochbahn operates daily during the summer season from early June to mid-October from 08:45 to 16:30 (and in winter from mid-December to late March). Summer lift fares (season 2025/2026): round trip adults approx. €21.50, seniors approx. €19.00, children (aged 6 to 15) approx. €12.00; small children ride free. Holders of the regional guest card Silbercard enjoy attractive discounts. Public transport: ÖBB trains to Schwaz station, from where the regional Silberregion hiking bus runs regularly up to Grafenast station. By car: via the Inntalautobahn A12, exit Schwaz, following the well-maintained mountain road via Schwazer Berg up to Grafenast/Pillberg; parking spaces are provided at the valley station.

Tips

Sturdy hiking boots with non-slip treaded soles and sure-footedness are required for the hike from the Hecherhaus to the Kellerjochkapelle, as the trail traverses rocky paths. On the panorama terrace of the Hecherhaus, treat yourself to a freshly poured Zillertaler beer and traditional Tyrolean Kaspressknödelsuppe while admiring an unobstructed bird's-eye view of the glittering ribbon of the Inn river.
